checks.name: coverage: >=98% of source land fills painted (source frame)
sea stays sea: <=0.5% of deep ocean land-painted
component count per region within +-1 (no fusion/fragmentation)
palette census: candidate flat colours <= source's + 2 (final rule awaits pinned palette, #145)
anchoring: >=97% of coastal ink marks still touch land
label integrity: every word keeps >=90% of its glyph pixels
no interior strokes absent from the source (<=30px tolerance)
deliverable identity: candidate hash recorded; publish step must match it
frame declaration: all assertions above sample the SOURCE-raster frame

note: mechanical PASS is necessary, never sufficient: an independent visual reviewer must read the pair-*.png packet and return ship/no-ship before any deploy.
